title: Yellowed Charred Dutch Zucchini Tagine
description: A charred and gooey Dutch dish featuring zucchini, perfect for a date night, made in a ceramic tagine and kneaded to perfection, this paleo-friendly recipe is a must try.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, paprika, cumin, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced zucchinis to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Heat a large skillet over medium high heat and char the zucchinis for 2-3 minutes on each side.
In the same skillet, add the chopped onions and cook until they are translucent.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for an additional minute.
In a ceramic tagine, combine the charred zucchinis, cooked onions and garlic, pitted dates, and sliced almonds.
Knead the mixture together until it is well combined.
Cover the tagine with a lid and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes.
